_about: Synthetic. A labelled retrieval set for the knowledge gateway's hybrid search (Sales ticket 45). Order, stock, quote, paint and invoice documents written alike, so the words of a query match many of them and only the exact code (PO number, item code, RAL colour, invoice number) names the one that answers it. Tenant `other` holds documents worded like the queries and full of the same codes: they must never be retrieved, and must not move `own`'s ranking.
